# Travel and Expenses Policy

Policy ID: FIN-POL-003.

## Section 4.1 Booking

All flights must be booked through the corporate travel portal. Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours.

## Section 4.2 Accommodation

Hotel costs are reimbursed up to $250 per night. In high-cost cities listed in Appendix B, the cap is $350 per night.

## Per Diem Rates

| Region | Daily meal allowance |
|---|---|
| Domestic | $75 |
| International | $100 |

Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances.
